sections.heading: Welcome to Kaafu Atoll
paragraphs: Kaafu Atoll, also known as Male' Atoll, is the most visited atoll in the Maldives and home to the capital city Male'. This atoll is divided into North Male' Atoll and South Male' Atoll, offering some of the most accessible and luxurious resort experiences in the country.

With its proximity to Velana International Airport, Kaafu Atoll is often the first taste visitors get of the Maldives' stunning beauty. The atoll features crystal-clear lagoons, vibrant coral reefs, and some of the most famous dive sites in the world.

sections.heading: Best Dive Sites in Kaafu Atoll
paragraphs: One of the first dive sites discovered in Maldives, famous for its dramatic overhangs and coral formations.
Excellent drift dive site with strong currents attracting large pelagics like sharks and rays.

sections.heading: Popular Activities in Kaafu Atoll
paragraphs: Explore vibrant coral gardens and marine life at house reefs of resorts or on snorkeling excursions.
Relaxing dhoni cruises at sunset, often with dolphin spotting opportunities.
Visit traditional fishing villages and experience authentic Maldivian culture.

sections.heading: Best Time to Visit Kaafu Atoll
paragraphs: The best time to visit Kaafu Atoll is during the dry season from November to April when you can expect calm seas, plenty of sunshine, and excellent visibility for diving and snorkeling.
The surf season runs from March to October, with the biggest swells typically in June-August.

sections.heading: Discover Kaafu Atoll Islands
paragraphs: Kaafu Atoll was absolutely breathtaking! The resorts were luxurious and the diving at Banana Reef was unforgettable. We saw so many colorful fish and even a turtle!
